messages.author: 1c54a45a48d07d08
messages.subject: removing x-ticks from scale_x_datetime()
parts:
Hi

Does anyone know how to remove ticks from x-axis using
scale_x_datetime()

the problem of + opts(axis.ticks=theme_blank()) is that it removes x
and y ticks

Thanks a lot

Af

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: removing x-ticks from scale_x_datetime()
parts:
Hi Af,

It's a bit of a hack, but you can just use a really long interval for
the major value:
scale_x_datetime(major = "100 years")

Hadley
